pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp, high-contrast edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank exhibit larger spatial area and higher angularity compared to smaller, more fragmented regions on the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming tri-point junction nodes. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the central flank, becoming more dense as patch size decreases ventrally.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile along the neck and upper shoulder line against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized discontinuity in the mane profile is visible where a dark avian organism is perched, occluding the continuous ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, localized region of grayish, textural disruption and de-pigmentation (consistent with Giraffe Skin Disease) is visible on the mid-to-lower flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-colored bird perched on the dorsal ridge at the base of the neck.
